quoted.Initial:41:0: "The dog is easier. That is the thing I keep landing on and then moving off, because it is not a nice thing to think about yourself. She does not need me to have got anything right."
quoted.Initial:3:0: "I suppose she is just there. That is the first thing. Bramble is just there, all the time. … The house is never empty now. Even when it is quiet it is not empty."
quoted.Initial:51:0: "She had a thorn in her foot and I had spent twenty minutes organising my own grief in advance, in traffic. … So that Saturday was a rehearsal. And I did not enjoy finding out that I have got the whole thing ready to go."
quoted.Initial:5:0: "It is like being caught. I am not a soppy person, or I did not think I was. … And I have started groaning back at her. That is the state of me now."
